infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Orbital uses Face ID to unlock your private vault and protect sensitive actions like deleting your account or exporting your data.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Allow Orbital to measure which Apple Search Ads campaign brought you here. This is used only for first-party attribution analytics — Orbital never tracks you across other companies' apps or websites.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Orbital reads recovery, heart rate, and sleep data from Apple Health to surface your nervous-system load, cardiac drift, and recovery hours alongside your capacity signal. Read-only — Orbital never writes to Health.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Orbital does not write to Apple Health. This permission is required by iOS even for read-only HealthKit access.
